review_response_tasks.rationale: 下雨是想早回家的原因，because；but转折与该理由不合，or提供选择而非当前因果。
tears及找不到哥哥表难过，sadeyes合语境；tall描述身高、fast速度不描述此处含泪眼神情绪。
不把小男孩单独留下而带去办公室，leave himalone；buy购买人或wash清洗人都不是这段陪同寻人的相对选择。
回答Ben/ClassFive先给姓名并附班级，name对应；age应给年龄、price金额不是这个回答。
SoonBen主语单数，全文现在时叙事，用arrives；arrive未作第三人称变化，arriving单独缺be不能作本句完整谓语。
带两件供两兄弟雨中保持干燥，且Lilynoumbrella随后受邀同行，umbrellas符合；notebooks/footballs不具这段常规遮雨用品功能。
with后用宾格us，指Ben与弟弟；we主格和our形容词性物主代词均不能独立作with宾语。
comewithus的邀请被后句三人同行承接，together；alone独自、apart分开与受邀一起走相反。

completed_passage:
When the school bell rings, Lily puts her things into her bag. She wants to go home early because it is starting to rain. On her way to the gate, she sees a small boy. Tears run down his face. His eyes look sad. “I cannot find my brother,” he says.

Lily does not leave him alone. She takes him to the school office. The teacher asks for his brother's name. “Ben, Class Five,” the boy says. The teacher makes a phone call. Soon Ben arrives at the door. He has brought two umbrellas, so both he and his brother can stay dry in the rain.

Lily can go home now, but she has no umbrella. “You can come with us,” Ben says. The three children walk to the gate together. They do not need to run through the rain.
